scenes.visualIntent: Reveal three distinct conceptual layers: algorithm, model, and AI system.
scenes.compositionIntent: Build a vertical stack of three luminous cards with distinct color identities and increasing scope.
scenes.motionIntent: Introduce the cards separately, then connect them with a single upward causal spine.
scenes.continuityBrief: Establish the cyan-violet-amber mapping and leave the algorithm layer active for the next Scene.

scenes.visualIntent: Show an algorithm as an explicit repeatable sequence of operations.
scenes.compositionIntent: Use a compact flow of compare, decide, and swap nodes while keeping the three-layer context visible.
scenes.motionIntent: Advance a marker through each rule step with frame-driven connectors and a deterministic loop.
scenes.continuityBrief: Inherit cyan as the active layer, then pass the resulting ordered data upward toward the model layer.

scenes.visualIntent: Show a model as a parameter structure shaped by training data rather than a list of rules.
scenes.compositionIntent: Transform ordered examples into a violet network whose parameter nodes settle into a learned pattern.
scenes.motionIntent: Pulse examples into the network, adjust parameter nodes, then hold a stable learned state.
scenes.continuityBrief: Receive data from the algorithm Scene and hand the stable violet model upward into an amber system shell.

scenes.visualIntent: Show the AI system as the full operating environment around the model.
scenes.compositionIntent: Place the violet model at the center of an amber ring of data, tools, permissions, monitoring, and human feedback.
scenes.motionIntent: Attach each operational component in causal order and animate one complete request-to-feedback loop.
scenes.continuityBrief: Expand the model into the full amber system, then compress all three layers into a unified stack for the conclusion.

scenes.visualIntent: Unify the training-method, trained-brain, and operating-organization analogy into one reliable value chain.
scenes.compositionIntent: Present the three persistent layers as a connected tower ending in a clear reliable-value output.
scenes.motionIntent: Replay the cyan-to-violet-to-amber handoff, then lock the complete system into a steady final state.
scenes.continuityBrief: Resolve all prior color and spatial motifs; finish with the full stack stable and visually complete.
